# StoppingCore.BranchCostCore

**分支费用执行**

对任意状态/输出类型与联合 PMF next，证明 branchCostRun 的结果/费用递推、halt 吸收与零新增费、正支持费用下编译 clock 的联合一致、三段守恒与同路径期望/截止，以及预算切片恢复不重抽后继。

**边界**：只给 PMF 层面的 receipt 倒计时，不含 fair-bit 采样、基本门计费或最小值算法专用停止。

**覆盖等级**：A-

| `Qatlib.Concepts.StoppingCore.BranchCostCore.unboundedMass_none` | theorem | L543 | The `none` mass of the unbounded execution is its nontermination mass. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.StoppingCore.BranchCostCore.unboundedMass_some` | theorem | L549 | The mass at `some (o, k)` is the joint mass of halting with output `o` and cost `k`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.StoppingCore.BranchCostCore.unboundedMass_tsum` | theorem | L553 | The mass function of the unbounded execution sums to one. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.StoppingCore.BranchCostCore.general_tsum_indicator_lt_ennreal` | theorem | L559 | The extended nonnegative sum of the indicators `n < k` over natural `n` is `k`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.StoppingCore.BranchCostCore.unboundedLaw` | def | L564 | The probability mass function of the unbounded execution, recording either nontermination or a halted output-cost pair. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.StoppingCore.BranchCostCore.general_tsum_const_nat_ennreal` | theorem | L570 | The extended nonnegative sum of a constant over the natural numbers equals infinity times that constant. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.StoppingCore.BranchCostCore.unboundedLaw_apply` | theorem | L572 | The unbounded execution law has point masses given by `unboundedMass`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.StoppingCore.BranchCostCore.general_tsum_tail_eq_cost_weighted_haltJoint` | theorem | L576 | Summing the halting tails over all cutoffs equals the joint halting sum weighted by the stopping time. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.StoppingCore.BranchCostCore.unbounded_nontermination_limit_and_joint_law` | theorem | L577 | The unbounded law combines the halting joint masses with the limit of the finite pending masses, and these masses sum to one. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.StoppingCore.BranchCostCore.general_unbounded_actual_expected_time` | theorem | L599 | The tail-sum execution time is the stopping-time-weighted halting mass plus infinity times the nontermination mass, so finite expected time forces nontermination mass zero. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.StoppingCore.BranchCostCore.general_online_cutoff` | theorem | L631 | Pending mass after `fuel` steps, multiplied by `fuel + 1`, is bounded by unbounded expected time, and hence by its quotient form after division. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.StoppingCore.BranchCostCore.general_output_event_cutoff` | theorem | L656 | For a finite output set, halting mass up to the fuel budget is at most eventual mass, which is at most that finite mass plus the pending probability. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.StoppingCore.BranchCostCore.general_unbounded_online_markov_and_event_cutoff` | theorem | L690 | Pending mass at budget `T` is at most expected unbounded time divided by `T + 1`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.StoppingCore.BranchCostCore.general_finite_output_mass` | theorem | L703 | The finite-run probability of output `o` equals the sum of its joint halting masses over times at most `T`. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.StoppingCore.BranchCostCore.general_zero_pending_budget` | theorem | L725 | If pending mass vanishes at budget `T`, then nontermination mass is zero and unbounded expected time is at most `T`. |
